title: JEPA-ICL: Progress-Aligned Latent Plans for In-Context Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Demonstrations show how a task can be completed, but differences in embodiment, appearance, and execution speed make it difficult to identify the guidance relevant to the robot's current progress. We introduce JEPA-ICL, a vision-language-action framework that couples predictive planning with demonstration learning. The policy learns to plan by predicting ordered future states in JEPA feature space up to subtask completion, capturing what remains to be accomplished. These plans guide action generation and locate relevant stages in demonstrations, whose JEPA-supervised content features provide progress-aligned context. Learning from this context, in turn, updates the shared policy that produces the plans and actions. This coupling connects anticipating the robot's own execution with reusing demonstrated experience. On the Imitator Game, JEPA-ICL achieves 80.0% seen-task success under C15 pretraining, outperforming Zero-WAM by 12.0 percen

translated_title: JEPA-ICL：面向上下文机器人操作的进度对齐潜在规划
translated_abstract: 演示展示了任务可以如何完成，但机器人本体、外观和执行速度的差异使得难以识别与机器人当前进度相关的指导信息。我们提出了JEPA-ICL，这是一个将预测性规划与演示学习相耦合的视觉-语言-动作框架。该策略通过在JEPA特征空间中预测有序的未来状态直至子任务完成来学习规划，从而捕获尚未完成的内容。这些规划指导动作生成，并在演示中定位相关阶段，其JEPA监督的内容特征提供了与进度对齐的上下文。从该上下文中学习反过来又会更新生成规划和动作的共享策略。这种耦合将预测机器人自身执行与重用演示经验联系了起来。在Imitator Game上，JEPA-ICL在C15预训练下实现了80.0%的已见任务成功率，比Zero-WAM高出12.0个百分点。
tldr: JEPA-ICL通过在JEPA特征空间中预测未来状态来学习规划，将预测性规划与演示学习相耦合，实现进度对齐的上下文机器人操作，在Imitator Game上达到80.0%的已见任务成功率。
en_tdlr: JEPA-ICL couples predictive planning by forecasting ordered future states in JEPA feature space with demonstration learning to achieve progress-aligned in-context robotic manipulation, attaining 80.0% seen-task success on the Imitator Game.
